senses.gloss: (b. h. יָחַשׂ; v. חוּס2) to connect, be connected.—Denom. יִחַס.
to trace the connection (יַחַס) of events or descent.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 17a:1">Meg. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי לְיַיחֵס בהן שנותיו וכ׳</he> (Rashi: <he>להִתְיַיחֵס</he>) in order to trace through them the years of Jacob (in which the principal events of his life occurred); <cite ref="Yevamot 64a">Yeb. 64ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 110">Yalk. Gen. 110</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 110">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 62:4">Gen. R. s. 62</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:12">Gen. XXV, 12</cite> sq.) <he>מה ראה הכתוב לייחס תולדותיו וכ׳</he> what reason was there for the Bible to insert here the genealogy of that &c.?—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82b:5">Snh. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>בא הכתוב ויִחֲסוֹ</he> the Scripture comes and records his genealogy (<cite ref="Numbers 25:11">Num. XXV, 11</cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 55b:7-14">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>אפשר … והכתוב מְיַחֲסוֹ</he> is it possible that he was a sinner and the Scripture would state his genealogy?; a. fr.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13:7">Num. R. s. 13</cite> <he>יִיחֲסוֹ הכתוב על שם שבטו</he> the Scripture distinguished him (giving him the privilege of the first offering) for the sake of his tribe (<cite ref="Numbers 7:12">Num. VII, 12</cite>).

Gen. R. s. 82 אין מְיַיחֲסִין ליוסף וכ׳ not Joseph is ranked in the records as the first-born; a. e.—Part. pass. מְיוּחָס, f. מְיוּחֶסֶת. pl. מְיוּחָסִים, מְיוּחָסִין; מְיוּחָסוֹת of traceable genealogy, of legitimate descent; of distinguished birth, well-connected.
<cite ref="Horayot 13a:19">Hor. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>שזה מי׳ וזה אינו מי׳</he> for this one (the Israelite) is of legitimate birth, and the other (the bastard) is not.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 70b:13">Kidd. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>משפחות מי׳ וכ׳</he> families in Israel of traceable descent.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 71b:9">Ib. 71ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מי׳ טפי</he> this one (who first ceased quarreling) is of nobler birth; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Peah 4:11">Tosef. Peah IV, 11</cite> <he>היתה מִתְיַיחֶסֶת עם וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>על</he>) claimed to be connected with Arnon, the Jebusite; Y. ib. VIII, 21ᵃ bot. <he>היתה מתי׳ של וכ׳</he> boasted to be descendants of &c.

senses.gloss: to be enrolled in genealogical lists, be recorded. Num. R. l. c. זכו להִתְיַ׳ וכ׳ they were privileged to have their genealogy recorded by the side of Moses.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>נ׳ ראש לשלשלת יוחסין</he> (not <cite ref="L00710"><he>לשלשת</he></cite>) he was recorded as the starter of a chain of genealogy (<cite ref="I Kings 14:21">I Kings XIV, 21</cite>). Gen. R. l. c. (expl.
<cite ref="I Chronicles 5">I Chr. V</cite>, I) <he>לא לראובן להתייחס</he> not to Ruben was genealogical priority to be given; a. fr.
